Super Smash Bros. Ultimate — The Party Game That Never Leaves the Shelf

Nintendo Switch · Updated 2026-08-05

Super Smash Bros. Ultimate is the definitive entry in Nintendo's mascot fighter, with the largest roster in the series and local multiplayer that works for everyone from kids to competitive players.

What's in the box

  • Base game — every fighter from series history, plus a story mode
  • Fighter Pass / DLC — adds guest characters (Joker, Banjo, Sora and more); buy only the ones you want
  • Physical vs digital — digital means no cartridge to lose at a party; physical holds trade value

Is the DLC worth it?

The base roster is enormous, so you don't need any DLC to enjoy it. Pick up individual fighters only if a specific character matters to you. The full Fighter Pass is for completists, not newcomers.
